details:
Project Details

On My Way To Home is an educational video game focused on space survival and exploration. It offers an interactive environment in which players take on the role of a stranded explorer who must build and manage a space station, collect resources, and complete missions to ensure survival in an environment beyond Earth while attempting to find a way back home.

The video game is designed to combine entertainment and scientific education through interactive activities inspired by NASA scientific information. Players will be able to explore an extraterrestrial environment while learning about its characteristics, understanding the challenges of surviving on a planet different from their own, and discovering the importance of essential resources such as water, oxygen, and energy for establishing future human settlements.

The main benefit of the project is to make scientific knowledge more accessible and engaging for younger generations. Through the incorporation of exploration, construction, resource management, and problem-solving mechanics, the video game encourages creativity, logical thinking, decision-making, and an interest in science, technology, astronomy, and space exploration.

The expected impact is to provide an educational alternative that encourages curiosity about the universe and helps users understand the challenges involved in human space exploration. Furthermore, the project aims to demonstrate how video games can become valuable tools for learning and scientific communication.

For its development, the team used various tools and technologies, including Godot Engine as the primary video game development platform, Visual Studio Code for programming, Pixelorama for creating pixel art graphic assets, PixelLab AI for generating visual elements, and Claude Code as an artificial intelligence assistant to support programming and code optimization. Additionally, several visual elements were designed and edited manually by the team, giving the video game a distinctive and personalized artistic identity.

The creative aspect of On My Way To Home lies in transforming the challenges of space exploration into an interactive adventure. Rather than presenting scientific information through traditional methods, the project allows players to experience and understand these concepts by actively participating in the video game.

Throughout the development process, the team considered scientific accuracy, educational value, gameplay accessibility, visual design, resource management mechanics, and the importance of creating an enjoyable experience. These factors guided the development process to ensure that the video game maintains a balance between entertainment, creativity, and scientific learning.
